snippet.title: Echoes of Mora - Gameplay Teaser
snippet.description:
Wishlist Echoes of Mora now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3129050/Echoes_of_Mora/
Embark on a mysterious episodic journey, filled with intriguing interactions and meaningful encounters, as you travel through time and explore a sunken village to help Mora find her lost brother. Playable in VR and non-VR on PC.

Echoes of Mora is developed by Selkies Interactive. We are a team of three game design master students from Berlin. In 2023, we established our own studio to work independently on passion projects.
We are supported by the DE:HIVE Institute from the University of Applied Sciences (HTW) (https://gamedesign.htw-berlin.de/dehive/) and funded by Medienboard Berlin-Brandenburg (https://www.medienboard.de/).

#indiegame #videogame #vr #gamedev #underwater #swimming #mystery #adventure #unrealengine
